info.name: USA Limousine Corporation API
info.description:
USA Limousine Corporation API. Variables live on this collection (no separate environment required).

Local API: {{base_url}} (http://localhost:3000/api/v1). Live API: {{live_base_url}} (https://api.usalimocorp.com/api/v1).
Live dashboards: admin {{live_admin_url}}, customer {{live_customer_url}}.

## Super admin
1. Super Admin → Auth → Login (saves the access token).
2. Bookings: Analytics, List, Get, Confirm, Complete, Cancel, Delete. Luggage, Vehicle Categories, Pricing, Extra Services, Tickets.
3. Notifications: list (cursor or page numbers), mark read / read all, delete. New support tickets and bookings arrive here in real time.

## Customer
1. Customers → Registration → 01 Register, then 02 Verify Email with the OTP from the email.
2. Customers → Authentication → Session → Login.
3. Public → Vehicle Categories / Luggage / Extra Services to pick IDs, then Bookings → 1. Create (status PENDING).
4. Bookings → 2. Manage: list, get, cancel, analytics. Settings: email + notification switches. Help Center: tickets.

## Realtime
Socket.IO on {{ws_url}} (no /api/v1). Auth: handshake `auth.token` = access token. Events: `notification.created`, `notification.read`, `notification.removed`.

If a request returns 401, run Login again (access token expired).

request.description: List vehicle category pricing tiers (`SUPER_ADMIN`). Supports pagination, sorting, and filters: `vehicleCategoryId`, `status` (ACTIVE/INACTIVE), and `pricingType` (FIXED/PER_UNIT/PERCENTAGE).
Get one vehicle category pricing tier by ID (`SUPER_ADMIN`).

Create a new vehicle category pricing tier (`SUPER_ADMIN`).

- `vehicleCategoryId`: ID of the vehicle category
- `minimumDistance`: min distance in km (e.g. 0)
- `maximumDistance`: null for infinite / unbounded distance (or max distance in km)
- `pricingType`: FIXED | PER_UNIT | PERCENTAGE
- `basePrice`: base price in EUR
- `perUnitRate`: optional rate per km
- `percentageRate`: optional percentage markup rate
- `status`: ACTIVE | INACTIVE
Update a vehicle category pricing tier (`SUPER_ADMIN`). All fields optional.
Delete a vehicle category pricing tier by ID (`SUPER_ADMIN`).
Bulk delete vehicle category pricing tiers (`SUPER_ADMIN`).

item.name: Customers
item.description:
Customer mobile auth (shared /auth endpoints).

Registration flow:
1. Registration → 01 Register (creates User + CUSTOMER role + Customer NORMAL, email OTP).
2. Set `email_verification_otp` from the email.
3. Registration → 02 Verify Email.
4. Authentication → Session → Login (saves customer_* tokens).

Do not send `channel` on register/resend — email OTP is the default.

item.name: Public
item.description:
Public APIs — no authentication required. Use these to browse the catalogue and create bookings.

**Flow:**
1. Vehicle Categories → List (sets vehicle_category_id)
2. Luggage → List (sets standard/luggage_type_id)
3. Extra Services → List (sets baby_seat_id, booster_seat_id, …)
4. Bookings → choose booking type to create & start checkout
